title: Loan-Program Part of the Appraisal Order Complexity Add-On
content:
The loan-program part of the Appraisal Order complexity add-on reads the loan program of the Mortgage Loan File the order supports:

- the Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed adds 100 dollars;
- the Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed adds 60 dollars;
- every other program adds nothing.

The loan-program part is added into the add-on subtotal of the complexity add-on.

**Program-by-program reading.**

| Loan program on the Mortgage Loan File | Loan-program part (USD) |
|---|---|
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 100.00 |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | 60.00 |
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 0.00 |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 0.00 |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | 0.00 |

*Question:* does the report type ordered decide this part? *Answer:* no; it reads the loan program on the loan file, whatever the report type.
